test.doc: REQ-P0-04: mean period over Hello 1..5 is 501 ms ± 1 ms virtual. Renode's RCC model derives the SysTick rate from the firmware's PLL writes (not the .repl's 480 MHz), so this is the "ideal clock" reference for the HW measurement (495.1 ms on the board, ~1.3 % fast).

suite.doc: P0 Blinky: the canonical ELF (build/fw/p0_blinky, built by `make fw` in the devcontainer) on Renode's STM32H743 platform plus the P0 overlay. Run: make test P=p0 [TAGS=smoke] Timeouts and timestamps are VIRTUAL time; thresholds are requirements (CLAUDE.md hard rule 7: change one only with a written reason).
